item.text: win_stay_lose_shift Uses Pavlov / win-stay-lose-shift: repeat after mutually cooperating or successfully exploiting, and switch after being exploited or mutual defection. It preserves cooperation with reciprocal opponents while exploiting unconditional cooperators more effectively. ```python # EVOLVE-BLOCK-START def policy(own_history, opponent_history): return 0 if len(own_history) == 0 else (0 if own_history[-1] == opponent_history[-1] else 1) # EVOLVE-BLOCK-END ```
